Its applicable guidance is Bedrock Guardrails' PII posture — mask rather than block, so context survives. This is stronger than the guidance's mechanism in the direction that matters here: the data is redacted AND bounded AND expiring AND excluded from export, so the residual is a short-lived owner-only excerpt rather than a masked durable corpus. Same scope-reduction-instead-of-key-management pattern DAS-9 used, which is starting to look like a deliberate house style.
